ABSTRACT
A module robot 100 includes a first link 10, a second link 20 movably linked to the first link 10, and a fluid pressure cylinder 30 configured to move the first link 10 and the second link 20 relative to each other, wherein the first link 10 has a cylinder block 32 in which a cylinder chamber 31 of the fluid pressure cylinder 30 is formed.
